task.prompt:
Goal: Expand Chu-kei Universe-first Plan Detection with 2-6 bounded tasks, prioritizing company-count coverage over deep-detail completeness. PR #246 / ade-batch-001 is merged. For each task select about 3 highest-priority not_checked companies from the current research-priority and Plan Detection registry/queue, excluding every code already present under operations/plan-detection/candidates and specifically 130A, 135A, 137A. Each task must create exactly one new unique batch JSON under operations/plan-detection/candidates/, beginning with ade-batch-002. Because each batch path does not yet exist, the planner MUST declare the exact new batch JSON path in that task's new_paths as well as allowed_paths; never reference a non-existent batch path only as allowed_paths. Use official or first-party primary sources only and preserve company/source/document identity, publication date, plan/version/period/fiscal semantics, currentness boundaries, and provenance. Never infer no_formal_plan from missing evidence or convert forecasts, visions, growth strategies, or policy statements into a formal medium-term plan without explicit evidence. Keep every candidate needs_review/pending, automatic promotion disabled, publication ineligible, and final registry mutation forbidden. Do not change registry/queue/overrides, public frontend data, human-review or Deep Verification decisions, production promotion, rankings, or evaluative claims. Run the existing Plan Detection candidate validator and npm run quality:v43 before every PR. Success is green bounded PRs expanding reusable L1 evidence while published Plan Detection state remains unchanged.
Outcome: Create one bounded non-public Plan Detection candidate batch from official or first-party primary sources, selecting distinct high-priority not_checked companies and preserving all review, publication, and promotion boundaries.
Scope discipline: implement only this task's stated outcome and acceptance. Do not add test code to non-test implementation files or implementation code to dedicated test files unless this task's outcome explicitly requires it.
Allowed paths: operations/plan-detection/candidates/ade-batch-002/candidates-v1.json
Acceptance: The new batch passes the existing Plan Detection candidate validator.; npm run quality:v43 remains green.; Published Plan Detection state remains unchanged and every candidate remains pending human review.
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.
task.title: Stage Plan Detection candidate batch ade-batch-002
